reviews.text:
I absolutely will not go there.

I went to several other hospitals.

I'm so glad I didn't have to undergo surgery that had no precedents! I would have regretted it.

I visited today before opening hours.
Our family has welcomed two cats into our home and have been coming to this hospital for a long time.
Today, I came to inform you of the passing of our second cat. Unfortunately, the day she became ill was a day off, so we were unable to see you, the doctor.
We had no choice but to go to another hospital, but sadly, the result was unfortunate. She was almost 19 years old, so it was a death from old age.
She was running around energetically until the day before, so I myself couldn't accept it at all. I couldn't even report it to you, the doctor, and spent my days just crying.
Today, I was finally able to come and report it.
I am truly grateful to the director and staff of Komazawa Animal Hospital for their care over the years.
When we first got our cats, you treated both of them simultaneously for many years, and five years ago, our eldest cat passed away from a serious illness, and you did everything you could to help her.
Now, our youngest cat has also passed away suddenly. She was quite old and lived a long life, and it was a peaceful death from old age.

The director and staff here treated me so kindly and patiently taught me so much, even though I'm inexperienced. I am truly grateful.

Thank you so much. Thank you. I can't express my gratitude enough.

I wanted to share this wonderful and kind hospital with others, so I'm writing this review.
Dr. Tanabe and all the nurses are very kind, and I feel completely at ease entrusting my medical care to them. Appointments are also easy to book.

I've been struggling with tear stains ever since I adopted my white dog, but thanks to the doctor at this hospital, that problem is gone.

I tried various foods and care products, but nothing improved the tear stains. After surgery and treatment, my dog's tear stains are now completely white.

I'm so grateful that I can now spend the time I used to spend on daily care playing with my dog!

Thank you.

My beloved dog was cared for at Komazawa Animal Hospital. Around this time last year, I wrote to express my gratitude for the wonderful care they provided for my 17-year-old dog and for watching over his growth over the years.

Komazawa Animal Hospital has been caring for my dog ​​since he was a puppy. When he had an allergic reaction to a vaccine, they identified the cause and responded quickly.

Also, when he collapsed due to a pre-existing condition, they responded courteously, even though it was right outside of business hours, and they kept an eye on him throughout the night. Having the doctors there to treat him was a great relief for my entire family, including my dog.

Also, around this time last year, he had a seizure and was unable to stand, so we went to the emergency room. We were told his heart was weak and he might not last even a day, so we decided to care for him at home. We headed to Komazawa Animal Hospital, where we had been caring for him for many years, to have him examined. I will never forget the look of relief on his face when he met the doctors, even though he had been listless and timid.
With the help of the doctors, over the course of about three weeks, he gradually regained his strength, was able to walk around the house, and was able to eat his favorite foods. We were able to spend irreplaceable time together as a family. Thank you for watching over him until the very end.

We believe that it was thanks to the support of Komazawa Animal Hospital that he was able to stay healthy for 17 years without any major illnesses or injuries.
Our whole family would like to express our gratitude. Again, we would like to say a big thank you.
We know you are busy every day, but please take care of yourself.

My 7-year-old cat has been coming here for about 5 years. The doctors, nurses, and staff are all very gentle, so I feel at ease bringing my cat here. 
My cat has a sensitive stomach, so I often have to come here, but thanks to the doctor's treatment, he is doing well.
Thanks to you, my child's life was saved. I'm truly grateful.

The hospital is very clean, and the head veterinarian and nurses make me feel at ease entrusting my timid pet to them! The veterinarian is very kind to animals and tries to find ways to minimize stress on each animal. I hope to continue having my pet treated at this hospital so that it can live a long and healthy life.

There's a problem with the head veterinarian.

They charged me extra fees without my consent, and when I asked questions, they acted like they were used to dealing with such cases, giving me a dismissive and exasperated response.

There are many better animal hospitals in the area, so I strongly recommend that anyone reading this find another hospital.

Whenever my cat catches a cold, we go to this hospital.

The head veterinarian doesn't force medication on us and treats our cats in the most natural way possible. The nurses are also very kind and gentle with our cats, so we feel completely at ease entrusting them with their care.

Komazawa Animal Hospital is the most trustworthy hospital for us. We look forward to continuing to use their services.
